hook: NVIDIA just turned your home devices into a distributed AI cluster.
spoken_script: NVIDIA just open-sourced PAIR, turning your home computers into a distributed AI cluster. PAIR auto-discovers local RTX GPUs, DGX Sparks, and Apple Silicon Macs via mDNS. Instead of choking one GPU, it load-balances agent requests across Ollama and LM Studio. Crucially, PAIR routes separate queries without pooling VRAM. All data stays strictly private on LAN.
